newsitem.title: USA: Mercury Finance controller denies charge-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Mercury Finance controller denies charge-WSJ.

text.p: An attorney for Mercury Finance Co Controller James Doyle told the Wall Street Journal Friday that his client denies Mercury's charges that he inflated the company's profits.
The paper quoted attorney Joseph Duffy as saying Mercury's assertions were "naive and self-serving" and that Doyle was cooperating with federal officials investigating the company.
A day earlier Mercury Finance said Doyle had disappeared amid a discovery that accounting irregularities had led the company to overstate its profits for the last four years.
The paper said people familiar with the matter believe the Securities and Exchange Commission is looking into Mercury's accounting.
